## Purpose

This document defines a template for the mandatory 200-300 word AI critique in HW01.

Goals:

* Critique AI output honestly
* Explain where AI was wrong, biased, or incomplete
* Connect AI limitations to concrete HW01 examples
* Show what the student learned about collaborating with AI
* Support the main report and oral defense

---

## Required Length

```text
200-300 words
```

Do not submit a bullet list as the final critique unless the instructor explicitly allows it. The final report asks for a paragraph-style critique.

---

## Critique Planning Table

| Question | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Where did AI help? |  |
| Where did AI get something wrong? |  |
| Where was AI biased, shallow, or incomplete? |  |
| Why did the AI fail? |  |
| How did human review correct it? |  |
| What principle did you learn? |  |
| Which AI observations support this critique? | AI-OBS-XXX |

---

## Draft Template

```text
During HW01, I used [AI tool] to support [research/test design/review]. The AI was useful for [specific useful task], but it also made important mistakes. For example, [AI-OBS-XXX or concrete mistake]. This mistake happened because [reason: missing context, overgeneralization, hallucinated assumption, weak source checking, etc.]. I verified the issue by [source or evidence checked] and corrected it by [human correction]. Another limitation was [second limitation if needed]. From this work, I learned that AI should be treated as a draft assistant, not as an authority. For testing work, I should use AI to brainstorm and compare ideas, but I must verify facts, inspect evidence, execute real tests, and make final judgments myself.
```

---

## Quality Checklist

* [ ] 200-300 words
* [ ] Mentions at least one concrete AI mistake
* [ ] Explains why the AI failed
* [ ] Explains how the student verified or corrected the mistake
* [ ] States a practical lesson for future AI collaboration
* [ ] Does not claim AI-generated content was accepted without review
* [ ] Matches evidence in prompt log and AI observations

---

## Final Notes

The critique should be reflective and specific. A generic statement that AI is "helpful but sometimes wrong" is not enough for HW01.
